_about: The south-east group (Stage 3, batch b6): rivers of Chattogram division that each reach the sea themselves — the Feni (with its tributary the Muhuri), the Sangu, the Matamuhuri and the Naf — grouped by region, as the user’s rule a of Stage 3 allows, not by a single main river. Each is its own main card, and choosing one lights its basin (its own lines and its branches).

feni.identified: Fifteen ways of OSM relation 11107595 «Feni River», every link sharing a node (this system’s extract), from Tripura along the border to the sea off Feni district, where OSM ends the line 20 m from the coastline. Not drawn: a second «Feni River» way, 1135046745 (14.5 km, Khagrachhari), joined to nothing. Drawn solid: it runs along the border for most of its course, so splitting it at COD-AB’s border would cut it into some eighty alternating pieces; the Naf, the border river with Myanmar, likewise.

join.source: OSM node 3967080174, the last node of way 167237578, the joint of the Feni’s ways 685982857 and 804767907

muhuri.identified: Three ways of OSM relation 19245682 «Muhuri River», from Tripura to the Feni at a shared node in Chhagalnaiya.

sangu.identified: Four ways tagged Sangu (this system’s extract), from the south of Thanchi north to 21.68°N: the first of four pieces.

sangu2.exempt: Unjoined: it begins 16.6 km from the piece above — over the 12 km a connector may bridge (the user’s rule, 2026-09-29) — and OSM has only one unnamed way between (257757462): no relation, no wikidata tag, no other spelling (ⓘ).
sangu2.identified: Three ways tagged Sangu, the second piece.

sangu3.identified: Five ways tagged Sangu, the third piece, 5.6 km below the second (a connector).

sangu4.identified: One way tagged Sangu, the last piece, 733 m below the third (a connector), to the sea at Banshkhali, where OSM ends the line 4 m from the coastline.

matamuhuri.identified: One way tagged Matamuhuri (this system’s extract), its upper 58.7 km in Bandarban. The rest, about 87 km to the coast, is an unnamed way (99374421) and ways named «Twain Khal»: not drawn (ⓘ).

naf.identified: Way 1223242401 of OSM relation 17630031 «Naf River», 56 km, to the estuary mouth off Teknaf. Not drawn: the relation’s head way 527726617, named «Modhur Chhora», another stream’s name (13.4 km).

entities.review: BWDB SE-12, the only Feni; SE-6 «ছোট ফেনী» is another river. B910 gives origin, entry and mouth; BWDB course, length, tributaries and distributaries. Conflicts in ⓘ: the entry (BWDB Matiranga, Khagrachhari; JRC Khagrachhari), the origin (JRC adds Khagrachhari) and the length (JRC 140 km; Banglapedia 115.85, en WP 116 recorded only). BWDB’s mouth, the Sandwip Channel at Musapur (Companiganj), is taken as the same place in other words (ⓘ notes). BWDB’s parts, 108 + 44 km, make 152, not its 153 (recorded only). Other names: MISSING in every source (row absent). Main cards carry no relation row; B910’s «প্রধান নদী» list is recorded only.

entities.review: BWDB SE-16, the only Muhuri by name; NC-51 «মাহারী» (Mymensingh), whose local name is «মুহুরী», ruled out by district. The books have it as a map label only (B-GEO). Relation from BWDB’s Feni tributary list (SE-12 §1.9). Other names null: both Wikipedias and Banglapedia give «ছোট ফেনী», which BWDB lists as a separate river (SE-6) — pending. Course null: BWDB gives only its upazila list. JRC’s origin «লুসাইপর্বত, ত্রিপুরা, ভারত» in ⓘ (decision 5). Wikipedia and Banglapedia put its meeting at the Feni’s mouth (recorded only; BWDB and JRC stand).

entities.review: BWDB EH-15, the only Sangu. The book gives origin, entry, length (BWDB and JRC agree, 294 km) and mouth; BWDB other names, tributaries, distributaries. Course null: BWDB’s §1.1 names «রামু» where its own §1.7 names «রুমা» — a source that contradicts itself (ⓘ). Wording variants, not conflicts: BWDB’s and JRC’s origin in the Arakan hills of Myanmar; BWDB adds the Remakri union to the entry and the Khankhanabad union (Banshkhali) to the mouth; «থানছি» / «থানচি». bn Wikipedia has it rise inside Bangladesh and join the Karnaphuli, contradicting every other source and itself (recorded only).

entities.review: BWDB EH-13, the only Matamuhuri; EH-8 «বুড়া মাতামুহুরী» is a separate river (its distributary). The book puts the source inside Bangladesh, at Lama’s Maivar hills; BWDB and JRC make it transboundary, rising on the Myanmar border and entering at Alikadam, upstream of Lama. So the entry is null (pending) and ⓘ gives both, and the course keeps only BWDB’s stretch below Lama. Length and mouth: the book’s; BWDB 141 km into the Moheshkhali river at Badarkhali, JRC 146 km — ⓘ. Other name from bn Wikipedia (the only source that gives one).

entities.review: BWDB EH-7, the only Naf. The book: the border river, its length and its mouth; BWDB: origin (as printed, «পার্বত্যঞ্চল»), entry, the Teknaf bank. Conflicts in ⓘ: the entry (JRC: Ukhia, Cox’s Bazar) and the length (BWDB 62, JRC 63). JRC’s origin is the same hills in other words. Other names: MISSING («নাফ নদ» is bn Wikipedia’s spelling), so the row is absent.
